messages:
Maya R.: Partner ask from EdgeSI + Datadog: short 12-min technical demo to show end-to-end traces, token-level latency, and a cache hit metric. Requested next Wed 11:00am PT. Need a concise runbook + collector config + dashboard.

Ethan V.: I can provide a minimal demo app that emits spans from the runtime and exports a `kv_cache.hit_ratio` metric. Will also include span attribute `model.variant` for comparison.

Carlos G.: I'll create a dashboard template (P50/P95 token latency, model latency flamegraph, traces table, cache hit sparkline). Will add a highlight panel for traces > 500ms. Delivery target: Tue EOD.

Datadog (Ryan): From Datadog side: use OTLP to trace.agent.datadoghq.com:443 with `DD-API-KEY` header. Keep sample rate high for demo; we can temporarily bump ingestion quota for staging.

Maya R.: Can we do a dry-run 20 mins before? Marketing needs a screenshot. Who can take it?

Ethan V.: I'll grab screenshot during dry-run. Note: for air-gapped customer show a proxy mode pointing to local dd-agent with cert-thumbprint in env.

EdgeSI Bot: Staging pool deploy scheduled to `staging-edgepool` in 10m. Logs stored at /var/log/edge-demo.

Carlos G.: Ops checklist I'll include: firewall outbound to trace.agent.datadoghq.com:443, collector sampler set to `always_on` for demo, revert instructions. Also add a small YAML snippet for OTEL collector.

Ethan V.: Demo command (staging):
```bash
export OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES="service.name=redwood-runtime,environment=staging,host.hw_vendor=edge-si"
export DD_API_KEY=REDACTED
./otelcol --config otel-collector-edge-si.yaml &
python demo_infer.py --model redwood-3b --prompt-file demos/edge_prompts.txt --emit-span --batch-size 6
```

Maya R.: Owners: Ethan (demo app + screenshot), Carlos (dashboard + runbook), Maya (calendar + marketing). Dry-run Wed 10:40am PT, demo Wed 11:00am PT. Post blocks here. :thumbsup:
